chunks.title: Official docs: NFT Airdrop — The Monster NFT Airdrop
chunks.text:
The Monster NFT Airdrop

When early access opens, **Monster NFTs** will be airdropped to the **top 5,000 trainers on the points leaderboard**.

**This is not first come, first served.** Monster NFTs are awarded on **points**, not on how early you signed up. Signing up does not reserve one — you have to earn your rank and hold it until the leaderboard locks.

There is no sale and no buying your way in. This airdrop is settled by the leaderboard: finish pre-registration inside the **top 5,000 trainers** on points and a Monster NFT is airdropped to you — with the top **2,000** receiving a **Genesis Legendary**, the founding set.

Once the leaderboard locks, this airdrop is closed for good. It finalises **one week before early access launch**, and we'll announce the exact date with plenty of notice (see Important Dates).

**Late to pre-registration? You are not locked out.** The leaderboard is points-based, so a trainer who signs up today and grinds daily can pass someone who signed up on day one and stopped showing up.

chunks.title: Official docs: NFT Airdrop — Who gets what
chunks.text:
Who gets what

| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| **1 – 3** | 🌩️ **Storm** + 🌫️ **Echo** |
| **4 – 10** | 🌩️ **Storm** + 👻 **Ghost** |
| **11 – 50** | 🌩️ **Storm** |
| **51 – 250** | 🌫️ **Echo** |
| **251 – 500** | 👻 **Ghost** |
| **501 – 2,000** | 🌸 **Bloom** |
| **2,001 – 5,000** | Rare Egg |
| **5,001+** | ❌ Not eligible |

chunks.text:
Meet the Genesis Legendaries

Four monsters, and where you finish decides which one lands in your wallet.

| 🌸 **Bloom** | Ranks 501 – 2,000 |

**Storm is the newest monster in the set**, and the hardest to earn — in this airdrop it goes to the top 50. The top **10** trainers receive Storm *and* a second Genesis Legendary alongside it, which is why the airdrop totals 5,010 Monster NFTs across 5,000 trainers.

chunks.title: Official docs: NFT Airdrop — How this differs from your egg and the free mint
chunks.text:
How this differs from your egg and the free mint

There are **three separate rewards**, and people mix them up constantly. The counter ticking up on pre-registration is the **Monster Egg** counter — it has nothing to do with this airdrop.

| | 🥚 **Monster Egg** | 🎁 **Trainer Point airdrop** | 🆓 **Ronin free mint** |

| **How many** | Up to 500,000 | 5,000 | **Coming soon** |
| **Decided by** | Sign-up order | Your points rank | Verified whitelist — one mint per trainer |
| **Is it an NFT?** | **No** | Yes | Yes |
| **Need a wallet?** | **No** | Yes | Yes |
| **How it reaches you** | Appears on your farm when you log in | Airdropped at early access | Minted to your wallet in mid-September |

**You can have all three, and one doesn't affect another.** Missing out on a Platinum egg does not hurt your airdrop chances — every trainer, whatever egg they claimed, competes for the same 5,000 Monster NFTs on points alone. Signing up first buys you a better egg; it buys you nothing on the leaderboard.

chunks.title: Official docs: NFT Airdrop — Why they matter
chunks.text:
Why they matter

These are some of the **strongest monsters in the game** — handed out for free, purely as a thank-you for your support in the lead-up to launch.

* **Genuinely powerful.** These monsters sit at the top end of the power curve. They aren't cosmetic collectibles; they're an edge you carry into the game from day one.
* **Fully tradable.** They're yours. Hold them, build around them, or trade them on-chain.
* **Specialised.** Some are built for **battle**. Some are built for **gathering**. Others excel at different corners of the game entirely. And some are simply stronger than others.

chunks.title: Official docs: NFT Airdrop — 👀 The Reveal Event
chunks.text:
👀 The Reveal Event

Here's the part worth waiting for: **you won't know what you got until launch.**

At early access launch we're running a **live Reveal Event** — a moment where every airdropped monster is unwrapped at once, and trainers finally see which creature they've been holding. Some trainers will walk away with a top-tier battler. Some will unwrap a gathering monster that quietly prints resources for months. A rare few will reveal something the rest of the world spends the season trying to trade for.

The free mint monsters get their own reveal earlier, on **14th October** — a month after that mint goes live and well ahead of launch.

Watch the reveal. Then find out where you landed.

chunks.title: Official docs: NFT Airdrop — How to secure your place
chunks.text:
How to secure your place

Every point counts, and rank is everything.

* **Nurture daily** — tap your egg every day and hold your streak.
* **Complete quests** — link Discord and Twitter, post weekly, show up in the community.
* **Refer friends** — every signup pushes you further up the board.
* **Free mint** — minting the Monster NFT on Ronin earns points toward your rank (see Free Mint).
* **Deposit early $FLOWER** — bigger deposits earn exponentially more points, and you keep the $FLOWER either way (see $FLOWER Deposits).

The board is live and moving. Every day you wait, someone else climbs past you — and every day you show up, you climb past someone who didn't.

**Pre-register, earn points, and climb into the top 5,000.**

chunks.title: Official docs: $FLOWER Deposits — Deposit early, climb the board
chunks.text:
Deposit early, climb the board

Yakkamon does not launch a new token — it reuses **$FLOWER**, the same ERC20 token used across our games. That means you can start building your in-game balance today, before early access even opens.

**Where to get $FLOWER**

$FLOWER is an ERC20 token available on **Base** and **Ronin**, with the same contract address on both chains:

`0x3E12b9d6A4D12cd9b4a6d613872d0Eb32f68b380`

**On Base**

* Buy: Swap for $FLOWER on Uniswap
* Token: $FLOWER on BaseScan

**On Ronin**

* Buy: Swap for $FLOWER in the Ronin Wallet
* Token: $FLOWER on the Ronin App

More info: $FLOWER ERC20 and tokenomics.

Always check the contract address matches the one above before swapping.

Every deposit you make during pre-registration does **two** things at once:

1. **It credits your in-game balance.** The $FLOWER you deposit is held for you and waiting the moment you get access to the game.
2. **It earns you pre-registration points.** Deposits convert straight into points on the leaderboard, and bigger deposits earn **exponentially** more.

You are not trading one for the other. You keep the $FLOWER *and* you keep the points — and those points push you toward the trainer tiers, earlier access waves, and the NFT airdrop.

chunks.title: Official docs: $FLOWER Deposits — What happens when you get access
chunks.text:
What happens when you get access

Once early access opens and you're in the game, your deposited $FLOWER is yours to use however you want:

* **Spend it in-game.** Use it across the game economy — gear, crafting, hunting supplies, and everything else $FLOWER buys (see What you can spend $FLOWER on below).
* **Withdraw it, tax-free.** Changed your mind, or just want it back? Withdraw your $FLOWER with **no withdrawal tax** from **Chapter 0** onward.

There's no lock-up and no penalty for taking your $FLOWER back out. Depositing early costs you nothing but earns you points.

**Marketplace & withdrawals open at Chapter 0** — one month after early access launch, once everyone from pre-registration is in the game and the system has been securely set up and tested. See Important Dates.

**Withdrawal limits at launch.** For security reasons, we may apply percentage-based withdrawal limits during the first few weeks after withdrawals open. This is a standard safeguard to protect the game economy and player funds while the project stabilises — it caps how much can be withdrawn in a given period, not whether you can withdraw. Limits are lifted as the project settles.

chunks.title: Official docs: $FLOWER Deposits — What you can spend $FLOWER on
chunks.text:
What you can spend $FLOWER on

$FLOWER exists to be **used inside the ecosystem**. It's the currency that moves the game economy, and the whole point of holding a balance is what it unlocks for you as a trainer — not sitting idle in a wallet.

Launch is where that starts. We're building a run of **early access offers** that are only available in the opening period, designed so the trainers who showed up early get the most out of their balance:

* **Discounted Gems.** Gems at early access rates — the best pricing we'll offer.
* **VIP access.** Unlock VIP status and the perks that come with it.
* **Exclusive purchasable items.** Launch-window gear, cosmetics, and collectibles you won't be able to pick up later.
* **Auctions.** Bid your $FLOWER on rare and one-off items going under the hammer — auctions open at **Chapter 0**.
* **In-game economy.** Crafting materials, hunting supplies, gear, and everything else that keeps your farm and your team growing.

That's the short list — more offers land as we get closer to early access, and we'll keep announcing them in the lead-up.

**The bigger your balance at launch, the more of these you can claim.** Early access offers are time-limited and, in the case of auctions and exclusive items, limited in supply too. Trainers who arrive with $FLOWER ready are the ones who get first pick.

chunks.title: Official docs: $FLOWER Deposits — In short
chunks.text:
In short

* Deposit $FLOWER now → earn points now.
* Bigger deposits → exponentially more points.
* At launch → put it to work on discounted Gems, VIP access, exclusive items, auctions, and the game economy.
* Prefer to take it out? → withdraw tax-free, no lock-up, from Chapter 0 onward.
* Early weeks → expect percentage withdrawal limits while things stabilise.

**Start collecting $FLOWER now — on** **Uniswap (Base)** **or** **Ronin Wallet swap** **— and deposit early to secure your rank.**

chunks.title: Official docs: Free Mint — Free Mint — 14th September
chunks.text:
Free Mint — 14th September

On **14th September**, the Yakkamon free mint goes live on the **Ronin Launchpad**. The NFTs are minted on the **Ronin blockchain**, so you'll need a Ronin wallet. Free to mint — you only pay gas.

chunks.title: Official docs: Free Mint — Hidden NFTs — reveal on 14th October :tada:
chunks.text:
Hidden NFTs — reveal on 14th October :tada:

**10,000 Genesis 'Hidden' Monster NFTs** are available to *mint*. You mint blind; every NFT is revealed on **14th October**.

Hidden in the drop are **68 legendaries** — 3 Storm, 5 Echo, 10 Ghost and 50 Bloom — plus 50 Rare and 9,882 Uncommon monsters. See the Yakkapedia for the full monster list.

Each monster will have unique stats & usable in game.

chunks.title: Official docs: Free Mint — Whitelisted waves
chunks.text:
Whitelisted waves

The free mint goes live in waves - check your eligibility below and make sure you don't miss out.

The whitelists will be finalised on the **10th of September** :calendar:

**This snapshot is only for the Ronin free mint.** It does not lock the **trainer airdrop** — that leaderboard keeps running and finalises separately, one week before early access launch (see Important Dates).

Wave | Supply | Details |
Wave 1
September 14th | 1,000 | Top 1,000 whitelisted leaderboard trainers — guaranteed mint
|
Wave 2
September 15th | 3,000 | Trainers ranked 1–10,000
(5 $FLOWER minimum deposit) 🔓
|
Wave 3 — Ronin Wave
September 16th | 2,000 | Active Ronin Gamers
Whitelist from Ronin Team
|
Wave 4
September 17th | 5,000 | Trainers ranked 1–20,000
5 $FLOWER minimum deposit)
Will end early if 10k supply is fully minted
|

September 18th - UTC 0 | Remaining | Trainers ranked 1-50,000
|
Ecosystem Airdrop
TBD | 1,500 | 1000 to top Ronin spenders
500 to FLOWER ecosystem players
|

**The 5 $FLOWER deposit prevents sybil attacks.** It is not a fee — the amount is fully withdrawable or spendable once the game goes live. See $FLOWER Deposits.

chunks.title: Official docs: Free Mint — How to mint?
chunks.text:
How to mint?

1. **Pre-register and verify** your account before 10th September.
2. **Deposit 5 $FLOWER** if you are minting in Wave 2 or Wave 4.
3. **Connect your Ronin wallet** to the Ronin Launchpad on mint day.
4. **Mint** when your wave opens. Keep gas in your wallet.
5. **Wait for the reveal** on 14th October to see which monster you got.

chunks.title: Official docs: Free Mint — FAQs
chunks.text:
FAQs

*What blockchain is the free mint on? Ronin — the NFTs are minted on the Ronin blockchain via the Ronin Launchpad, and you'll need a Ronin wallet with a little RON for gas.*

*What is the total supply that will be revealed on 14th of October - 11,500*

*Can I mint more than one? Yes, if you meet the eligibility requirements in each wave. You can only mint a maximum of 1 per wave.*

*How do I use them? Once early access begins, you will be able to deposit them into the game*

*Can you trade hidden NFTs? Yes, these are NFTs that can be traded prior to reveal.*
